snippet.title: Starfield - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Starfield's biggest free update yet, Free Lanes, and the new story DLC, Terran Armada, are both coming on April 7, bringing a new robotic threat, new tech, a new companion, and major upgrades to space travel, customization, New Game+, and much more. Best of all: Starfield is also officially launching on PlayStation 5 on April 7! 

#ps5 #ps5games #starfield 

Rated Mature
